title: From Ukraine to the UK and Beyond: Самооцінювання
title_uk: Україна, Велика Британія та світ: Самооцінювання
rule: Оціни конкретні вміння. Наведи приклад своєї роботи та визнач, що повторити.
example: If we had checked the opening hours, we would have arrived earlier.
reading: Emma is planning a trip with friends and compares cities in Ukraine and the UK. She wants to learn about landmarks rather than only take photographs. Dan checks routes and public transport. They practise asking for directions politely and giving clear instructions. A good travel plan includes time for museums, local food and a place to rest.
